sections.heading: Your quote and cleaning scope
paragraphs: These terms accompany your final written quote and Scope of Works. Together, they describe the agreed cleaning services, frequency, price and responsibilities.
Remote estimates remain indicative until the premises and requirements have been reviewed. Only the rooms, areas, tasks and frequencies included in the final agreed scope are included in the price.
The overall cleaning frequency does not mean every task is performed at every visit. Individual tasks are completed at the frequencies shown in the agreed Scope of Works.
The quotation is valid for 30 days from its issue date, as shown by the expiry date on the quote. After that date, pricing and availability must be reconfirmed before acceptance.
Any special conditions must be agreed in writing before services commence.

sections.heading: Service arrangements
paragraphs: Secure Cleaning coordinates the cleaning arrangement and nominates a service provider to carry out the cleaning. The service provider is responsible for day-to-day performance. Secure Cleaning remains available to assist with service concerns and coordination.
The service provider's identity, billing party, commencement date and payment arrangements will be confirmed before services begin. Receiving a quote alone does not commence the service.
Before commencement, the client and service provider will confirm access, alarms, emergency procedures, site requirements and contact details for routine communication and urgent issues.

sections.heading: Ongoing service - no fixed minimum term
paragraphs: Services continue on an ongoing basis from the agreed commencement date. There is no fixed minimum term and no early termination fee.
A fixed-term contract can be supplied upon request, with its terms agreed separately.

For the ongoing arrangement, the client, service provider or Secure Cleaning may end the service by giving at least 30 days' written notice, without needing to provide a reason. Services continue during the notice period unless a different arrangement is agreed.
The client pays for services properly supplied up to the agreed end date. Nothing in this clause limits any right to end the arrangement sooner under clause 11 or applicable law.

sections.heading: What the cleaning price includes
paragraphs: Unless the quote states otherwise, the price includes routine cleaning labour, ordinary cleaning equipment and cleaning chemicals needed to perform the agreed scope.

Client consumables - including toilet paper, hand towels, hand soap, bin liners and sanitary products - are excluded unless expressly included in the quote. Any agreed supply of consumables will be separately identified.
Cleaning will be performed with due care and skill, in accordance with the agreed scope and applicable safety requirements.
Cleaning chemicals must be appropriately labelled, safely handled and securely stored. Current Safety Data Sheets for products used at the premises will be available on request.

sections.heading: Excluded services and additional work
paragraphs: Unless expressly included, the quote excludes specialist work such as external or high-access window cleaning, carpet extraction, pressure washing, pest treatment, mould remediation, hazardous-material removal, sharps handling and specialist decontamination.
An initial deep clean may be recommended to bring the premises to a maintainable standard. This is separately quoted and only carried out with the client's approval.
Additional work or changes to the agreed scope, frequency or service times must be agreed in writing, including any price adjustment, before the work proceeds.

sections.heading: Prices, GST and payment
paragraphs: The quote identifies the service price and whether GST is included or additional. Where stated as excluding GST, GST will be added where applicable.
Invoices will be issued by the confirmed billing party, using the invoicing frequency and payment terms confirmed before commencement. The applicable payment deadline must be clearly identified.
Payment to the billing party satisfies the payment obligation for the relevant invoice.
Please raise any genuine invoice query promptly. Undisputed amounts remain payable by the agreed due date.

sections.heading: Price reviews
paragraphs: The cleaning fee may be reviewed annually, beginning no earlier than 12 months after commencement.

Any proposed change will be explained in writing at least 30 days before its proposed commencement. Changes to the agreed scope or price require written agreement; a proposed increase is not treated as accepted merely because the client has not responded.

The client may end the service before a proposed increase takes effect by giving notice within the review period, without an early termination fee. If less than 30 days remains before the proposed increase, the existing price continues until the notice period ends, unless otherwise agreed.

sections.heading: Access, closures and client responsibilities
paragraphs: The client must provide safe and timely access, accurate access instructions, electricity, hot and cold water, and any agreed storage facilities.

Please disclose relevant hazards, restricted areas, induction requirements, alarm procedures and any special requirements for surfaces or chemicals before cleaning starts, and advise promptly of changes.
The client should secure valuables, confidential documents and fragile items, and nominate a contact for access issues and service changes.

Please advise your cleaner of planned closures as early as reasonably possible. Cleaning on public holidays, any rescheduling and any additional charge must be agreed beforehand. No public-holiday surcharge applies unless agreed.
The client will not be charged for cleaning visits agreed to be cancelled because of a closure or public holiday.

If a scheduled visit cannot proceed because access is unavailable, the service provider will make reasonable attempts to contact the client. Any missed-access charge must have been agreed in writing beforehand and be reasonable in the circumstances.

sections.heading: Security, privacy and safety
paragraphs: Keys, passes, alarm codes and confidential information must be protected and used only for the agreed services. Loss or suspected compromise must be reported promptly.
Either party may pause affected work where there is a genuine safety risk. The parties will cooperate to resolve the issue and minimise disruption.
Charges will be adjusted for services not supplied, subject to any separately agreed, reasonable missed-access charge.

sections.heading: Service concerns and rectification
paragraphs: Please report cleaning concerns promptly to the service provider or Secure Cleaning, with sufficient detail to identify the issue.

Where the service provider is responsible, it will investigate and rectify the issue within a reasonable time at no additional charge. Unresolved or repeated concerns may be escalated to Secure Cleaning.
This process does not restrict any remedies available under applicable law.

sections.heading: Ending services for a serious problem
paragraphs: A party may end the arrangement if another party materially breaches its obligations and does not remedy the breach within 10 business days after receiving written notice.
Affected services may be suspended, or the arrangement ended immediately where justified, for serious safety misconduct, fraud, unlawful conduct or loss of required insurance.
On termination, access items must be returned and access credentials disabled or securely removed as appropriate.

sections.heading: Insurance and responsibility
paragraphs: The service provider must maintain public liability insurance of at least $10 million, workers compensation insurance where legally required, and any other insurance agreed for the services. Evidence of currency is available on reasonable request.

Each party remains responsible for loss caused by its breach, negligence or unlawful conduct. Nothing in these terms excludes, restricts or modifies rights or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded, including applicable Australian Consumer Law guarantees.

sections.heading: Service continuity
paragraphs: If the nominated service provider cannot continue, Secure Cleaning may propose a suitably qualified replacement after consultation with the client. The replacement and any changes to billing or service arrangements will be confirmed before the replacement starts.

Where an event beyond a party's reasonable control prevents cleaning, that party must promptly advise the others and take reasonable steps to reduce disruption. The client will not be charged for cleaning services that are not supplied.

sections.heading: Acceptance, confirmation and contact
paragraphs: The client's acceptance of the final quote, Scope of Works and these terms must be recorded in writing, including by email or an online acceptance process, before services commence.

The service provider's identity, billing party, commencement date and payment arrangements will be confirmed before services begin. These operational details do not require a separate signed document.

Any subsequent variation to the agreed scope, price or these terms must be agreed in writing. A separately signed service agreement, including a fixed-term contract requested by the client, takes precedence only to the extent it expressly changes these terms.
For service questions, complaints or cancellation notices, contact your nominated representative and copy info@securecleaning.com.au.
